sloka: साधु वानर वीर्येण श्लाघनीयो ऽसि मे रिपुः ।रावणेनैवमुक्तस्तु मारुतिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।। ६.५९.६५ ।।।।
transliteration: sādhu vānara vīryeṇa ślāghanīyo 'si me ripuḥ ।rāvaṇenaivamuktastu mārutirvākyamabravīt ।। 6.59.65 ।।।।

translations.english: Ravana having spoken in that way, Maruti said "Oh Ravana! What a shame on my valour, you survived."
